title: {item:tibia_violence}
text:
最后是一根{item:tibia_violence}。它带着{faith:brute}的印记，但{b}不是信物{/b}：放进包里不会换神，只在你信{faith:brute}的时候多出一截效果；换了别的神，它那几行字会变灰（休眠），只剩普通的那部分。

前面是休息点，有神坛。

texts.en:
Last, a {item:tibia_violence}. It bears the mark of {faith:brute}, but it's {b}not an Anchor{/b}: putting it in your bag won't switch gods. It just does a bit more while you follow {faith:brute}. Follow a different god and those lines turn grey (dormant), leaving only the plain part.

The rest stop ahead has an altar.
